_comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings. Commit this file to git so the team shares the same hook set. Per-user overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). NOTE: agents/skills/commands/memory need no keys here — Claude Code discovers .claude/agents/, .claude/skills/, .claude/commands/ and CLAUDE.md by fixed convention; the schema this file pins has no such keys, and shipping invalid keys is the dead-config anti-pattern the opencode adapter documents.
_hooks_comment: UserPromptSubmit runs route-hook.py on every prompt and injects its output (hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) so the route-first step happens deterministically. Both Claude Code AND VS Code Copilot (Agent Hooks, Preview) read this .claude/settings.json hooks block. Path: Claude Code sets $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to the repo root even when the session cwd is a subdirectory, so use it; Copilot falls back to $PWD (its hook cwd is the workspace root). Trailing '|| true' makes it FAIL-OPEN — a hook must never block a prompt.
